newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 60,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 60,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought two shipments totalling 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at a tender on Friday, traders said.
Cargill, Marubeni, Mitsui and Itochu each sold parts of the shipment, traders said.
The shipments contain Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW).
The first shipment's freight was fixed at US$19.40 per tonne and the second at US$20.40 per tonne -- both for delivery from the Pacific Northwest.
